# Support

How to get help depends on what you're using. The terms are those of the
[Candor UI Commercial Licence](https://candor.themethodic.com/licence), section 4, which is the source if these ever differ.

| Tier | Support |
|---|---|
| **Free** (this repository, MIT) | Public issues here, and the docs. Issues are read; there's no promised reply time. |
| **Pro** | No email support. The docs and examples at https://candor.themethodic.com, and public issues for the free items. |
| **Premium** | Email at **info@themethodic.com**, answered on a best-effort basis. |
| **Team** | Priority email at **info@themethodic.com**: a first reply within 2 business days (Monday to Friday, US public holidays excepted). |

Support covers Candor UI's own code, not your application, and a reply is not a promise of a fix.

## Where to ask

- **A bug or a gap in a free item, or in this repository's docs or starters:** open an issue here. Use the form, and say
  the item, the version and what you expected.
- **A paid item (Pro, Premium or Team), your licence, a refund or a licence key that isn't working:** email
  info@themethodic.com. Paid source isn't in this repository, so an issue here can't show it, and **never paste a
  licence key into an issue, a pull request or a comment**: they are public. If you have, email us and we'll replace it.
- **A security problem:** don't open an issue. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
- **Questions about using Candor:** the docs at https://candor.themethodic.com/docs, the patterns at
  https://candor.themethodic.com/patterns, and `npx candor-ui doctor` for an install that looks wrong.
